from store import Receipt, ReceiptLine
from store.cart import Cart, Item


def test_issue_example_save10_discount_tax_total():
    """Example: 1000/2000/3005 with SAVE10 gives discounts 100/200/300 taxes 72/144/216 total 5837."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="a", name="A", price_cents=1000))
    cart.add(Item(sku="b", name="B", price_cents=2000))
    cart.add(Item(sku="c", name="C", price_cents=3005))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    receipt = cart.receipt()
    # subtotal 1000+2000+3005=6005; discount 6005*10//100=600
    # discount floors: 600*1000//6005=99, 600*2000//6005=199, 600*3005//6005=300; leftover 2 to first two => 100,200,300
    assert [line.discount_cents for line in receipt.lines] == [100, 200, 300]
    # discounted 6005-600=5405; tax 5405*8=43240/100=432.4=>432
    # tax floors on nets 900/1800/2705: 432*900//5405=71, 432*1800//5405=143, 432*2705//5405=216; leftover 2 to first two => 72,144,216
    assert [line.tax_cents for line in receipt.lines] == [72, 144, 216]
    # total 5405+0+432=5837 (shipping 0 since 5405>=5000)
    assert receipt.total_cents == 5837  # 5405+0+432=5837


def test_issue_empty_cart_receipt_is_zero():
    """An empty cart gives a receipt with no lines and every total 0."""
    cart = Cart()
    receipt = cart.receipt()
    assert receipt.lines == []  # no lines
    # all totals 0
    assert receipt.subtotal_cents == 0  # empty sum=0
    assert receipt.discount_cents == 0  # no coupon=0
    assert receipt.shipping_cents == 0  # empty has no shipping=0
    assert receipt.tax_cents == 0  # 0*8%=0
    assert receipt.total_cents == 0  # 0-0+0+0=0


def test_issue_gross_and_net_use_qty():
    """gross_cents is price_cents times qty and net_cents is gross minus discount."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="k", name="K", price_cents=199, qty=3))
    receipt = cart.receipt()
    line = receipt.lines[0]
    # gross 199*3=597; discount 0 (no coupon); net 597-0=597
    assert line.gross_cents == 597  # 199*3=597
    assert line.discount_cents == 0  # no coupon=0
    assert line.net_cents == 597  # 597-0=597
    # tax 597*8=4776/100=47.76=>48; single line takes all 48
    assert line.tax_cents == 48  # 597*8=4776/100=47.76=>48
    assert line.qty == 3  # qty preserved=3
    assert line.sku == "k"  # sku preserved
    assert line.name == "K"  # name preserved


def test_issue_discount_tie_goes_to_earlier_line():
    """Leftover discount cents go to largest remainder, ties to the earlier line."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="s1", name="S1", price_cents=25))
    cart.add(Item(sku="s2", name="S2", price_cents=25))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    receipt = cart.receipt()
    # subtotal 25+25=50; discount 50*10//100=5
    # floors 5*25//50=2 each (rem 25 each); leftover 5-4=1 to earlier => 3,2
    assert [line.discount_cents for line in receipt.lines] == [3, 2]  # 2+1=3, 2=2
    assert receipt.discount_cents == 5  # 50*10//100=5


def test_issue_fixed_discount_split_sums_exactly():
    """Line discounts sum exactly to the cart discount with largest-remainder leftovers."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="a", name="A", price_cents=1000))
    cart.add(Item(sku="b", name="B", price_cents=1000))
    cart.add(Item(sku="c", name="C", price_cents=1000))
    cart.apply_coupon("FIVEOFF")
    receipt = cart.receipt()
    # subtotal 1000+1000+1000=3000; discount flat 500 (3000>=2000)
    # floors 500*1000//3000=166 each (rem 2000); sum 498 leftover 2 to first two => 167,167,166
    assert [line.discount_cents for line in receipt.lines] == [167, 167, 166]  # 166+1=167, 166+1=167, 166=166
    assert sum(line.discount_cents for line in receipt.lines) == 500  # 167+167+166=500
    assert receipt.discount_cents == 500  # flat 500


def test_issue_tax_split_proportional_to_net():
    """The cart tax is split across lines in proportion to net_cents."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="a", name="A", price_cents=25))
    cart.add(Item(sku="b", name="B", price_cents=25))
    cart.add(Item(sku="c", name="C", price_cents=25))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    receipt = cart.receipt()
    # subtotal 25+25+25=75; discount 75*10//100=7; floors 7*25//75=2 each leftover 1 to first => 3,2,2
    # nets 25-3=22, 25-2=23, 25-2=23; net total 75-7=68
    # tax 68*8=544/100=5.44=>5; floors 5*22//68=1, 5*23//68=1, 5*23//68=1 leftover 2 to largest rems (47,47) => 1,2,2
    assert [line.discount_cents for line in receipt.lines] == [3, 2, 2]  # 2+1=3, 2=2, 2=2
    assert [line.tax_cents for line in receipt.lines] == [1, 2, 2]  # 1=1, 1+1=2, 1+1=2
    assert receipt.tax_cents == 5  # 68*8=544/100=5.44=>5


def test_issue_receipt_totals_equal_cart_numbers():
    """Receipt totals equal the cart numbers with total as subtotal minus discount plus shipping plus tax."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="a", name="A", price_cents=1200, qty=2))
    cart.add(Item(sku="b", name="B", price_cents=800))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    receipt = cart.receipt()
    # subtotal 1200*2+800=3200; discount 3200*10//100=320; discounted 3200-320=2880
    # shipping 599 (2880<5000); tax 2880*8=23040/100=230.4=>230; total 2880+599+230=3709
    assert receipt.subtotal_cents == 3200  # 2400+800=3200
    assert receipt.discount_cents == 320  # 3200*10//100=320
    assert receipt.shipping_cents == 599  # 2880<5000=>599
    assert receipt.tax_cents == 230  # 2880*8=23040/100=230.4=>230
    assert receipt.total_cents == 3709  # 2880+599+230=3709
    assert receipt.subtotal_cents == cart.subtotal_cents()  # equals cart subtotal
    assert receipt.discount_cents == cart.discount_cents()  # equals cart discount
    assert receipt.shipping_cents == cart.shipping_cents()  # equals cart shipping
    assert receipt.tax_cents == cart.tax_cents()  # equals cart tax
    assert receipt.total_cents == cart.total_cents()  # equals cart total


def test_issue_lines_in_cart_order():
    """Receipt lines are in cart order."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="s1", name="First", price_cents=100))
    cart.add(Item(sku="s2", name="Second", price_cents=200))
    cart.add(Item(sku="s3", name="Third", price_cents=300))
    receipt = cart.receipt()
    # order added s1,s2,s3
    assert [line.sku for line in receipt.lines] == ["s1", "s2", "s3"]  # insertion order
    # gross 100,200,300
    assert [line.gross_cents for line in receipt.lines] == [100, 200, 300]  # 100*1,200*1,300*1


def test_contract_percent_coupon_rounds_down():
    """A percent coupon takes that percent off the whole subtotal, rounded down."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="a", name="A", price_cents=99))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    # discount 99*10//100=9 (9.9 floored)
    assert cart.discount_cents() == 9  # 99*10//100=9


def test_contract_shipping_free_threshold():
    """Shipping is free when discounted subtotal is $50 or more, else flat $5.99, empty has none."""
    cart_free = Cart()
    cart_free.add(Item(sku="a", name="A", price_cents=5000))
    # discounted 5000>=5000 free
    assert cart_free.shipping_cents() == 0  # 5000>=5000=>0
    cart_paid = Cart()
    cart_paid.add(Item(sku="b", name="B", price_cents=4999))
    # discounted 4999<5000 charge
    assert cart_paid.shipping_cents() == 599  # 4999<5000=>599
    cart_empty = Cart()
    assert cart_empty.shipping_cents() == 0  # empty=>0


def test_contract_tax_half_up_and_shipping_untaxed():
    """Tax is 8% of the discounted subtotal, rounded half up, shipping is not taxed."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="a", name="A", price_cents=1000))
    # tax 1000*8=8000/100=80 (shipping 599 not included; with shipping would be 1599*8/100=127)
    assert cart.tax_cents() == 80  # 1000*8=8000/100=80
    cart2 = Cart()
    cart2.add(Item(sku="b", name="B", price_cents=45))
    # tax 45*8=360/100=3.6=>4
    assert cart2.tax_cents() == 4  # 45*8=360/100=3.6=>4
